properties.text: [34] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced west of Odradne (east of Velykyi Burluk).[35] Russian milbloggers continue to make spurious claims about an encirclement in northeastern Kharkiv Oblast.

Russian Subordinate Main Effort #2 – Advance on the Fortress Belt from the east Russian objective: Advance on Slovyansk, Kramatorsk, and Druzhkivka from the east – assessed objective of the Russian 3rd Combined Arms Army and Southern Grouping of Forces elements Russian forces recently conducted an infiltration mission near Chasiv Yar.

Russian Subordinate Main Effort #2 – Advance on the Fortress Belt from the east Russian objective: Advance on Slovyansk, Kramatorsk, and Druzhkivka from the east – assessed objective of the Russian 3rd Combined Arms Army and Southern Grouping of Forces elements Ukrainian forces recently advanced east of Slovyansk.

A Russian milblogger claimed on September 14 that Russian forces advanced west of Muravka and into Marivka (both northeast of Novopavlivka).[68] Neither Russian nor Ukrainian sources reported ground activity in the Oleksandrivka direction on September 15.
